_comment: Catalog for Delaly Art. To add a new exhibit: 1) drop images into public/art/, 2) add an exhibit object below, 3) add artwork objects pointing at it. Then run: node scripts/build.js

artworks.blurb: The old beacon tower holds its post beneath a sky gone electric — cobalt swirls and molten stars over Lake Michigan.
artworks.title: Starry Breakwater

artworks.blurb: Dawn dissolves into dabs of light; the breakwater softens into a watercolor memory of the lake.
artworks.title: Morning on the Shoreline

artworks.blurb: Time melts along the shoreline as the breakwater drifts into a dream only the lake remembers.
artworks.title: The Persistence of the Lake

artworks.blurb: Prussian-blue rollers curl beneath the lonely tower — a woodblock hymn to the inland sea.
artworks.title: The Great Wave at the Beacon

artworks.blurb: Sunset pours molten gold across the surf; the horizon dissolves into pure radiance.
artworks.title: Light Over Still Water

artworks.blurb: A thousand patient dots of color rebuild the beach — pointillism's quiet, shimmering arithmetic.
artworks.title: Sunday on the Sand

artworks.blurb: Ornamental gold leaf weaves through sky and surf; the breakwater becomes a jeweled frieze.
artworks.title: The Golden Shore

artworks.blurb: The lake simplifies into bold bands of feeling — pink, blue, and the long breath of evening.
artworks.title: Pink Horizon

artworks.blurb: The shoreline undulates with feeling; two small figures sit inside a melancholy only dusk understands.
artworks.title: Anxiety at Dusk

artworks.blurb: The pier, the walker, the waves — fractured into interlocking planes of rose and blue.
artworks.title: Cubist Lighthouse

artworks.blurb: The seascape dissolves into pure color-field meditation — mauve and blue breathing against each other.
artworks.title: Fields of Dusk

artworks.blurb: Vast water, luminous horizon — a romantic meditation on the infinite at the lake's edge.
artworks.title: The Sublime Shore

artworks.blurb: Feathery light dances across rippled sand; an impression of warmth you can almost feel.
artworks.title: Sand in Sunlight

artworks.blurb: Short, deliberate strokes build the shore into solid, sculptural planes of color.
artworks.title: Construction of a Beach

artworks.blurb: A cheerful naive vision — flat vivid color, a wading dog, and the lighthouse pier beyond.
artworks.title: The Dog at the Breakwater

artworks.blurb: Chiaroscuro drama: golden moonlight strikes the breakwater while the night holds its breath.
artworks.title: Moonlight on the Rocks

artworks.blurb: Wild, joyful color — emerald water, vermilion rocks — the beach as pure exuberance.
artworks.title: Fauve Shoreline

artworks.blurb: The shoreline as pop icon — high-voltage color blocks, silkscreen swagger, dog included.
artworks.title: Beach, in Neon

artworks.blurb: A misty tonal harmony of grays — the beach at its most quiet and poetic.
artworks.title: Nocturne in Gray and Silver

artworks.blurb: Towering clouds gather over the shore — romantic naturalism, painted with weather in its veins.
artworks.title: Cloud Study Over the Lake

artworks.blurb: Elongated shadows and a bruised, tenebrous sky — the beacon tower stands as a spiritual sentinel over the rocks.
artworks.title: The Tower in the Storm

artworks.blurb: Stark and cinematic — an empty beach under a held breath of gray light. Nobody is coming; that is the point.
artworks.title: Solitude, Lake Michigan

artworks.blurb: Ominous and brooding — the lake turns inward, all shadow and undertow, in the manner of the Black Paintings.
artworks.title: The Dark Lake

artworks.blurb: A floating dreamscape — the beacon tower spirals skyward through blossoms, gulls, and pastel stones.
artworks.title: The Tower Dreams in Flowers

artworks.blurb: Ben-Day dots and bold primaries turn the old tower into a comic-strip icon. Lake Michigan, but make it pop.
artworks.title: Beacon! (A Pop Shoreline)

artworks.blurb: Playful biomorphic shapes dance across the rocks — the beach reimagined as a star chart.
artworks.title: Constellation Over the Breakwater

artworks.blurb: Crisp, deadpan surrealism — an ordinary beach rendered quietly impossible. Ceci n'est pas une plage.
artworks.title: The Treachery of the Shore
The Beacon at Midnight
artworks.blurb: Moonlight pours silver over the breakwater; the sea holds its breath beneath the tower.

artworks.title: Stillness After Dark
artworks.blurb: The lake goes glassy under a soft nocturnal glow; even the rocks seem to listen.

artworks.title: Lunar Inquiry
artworks.blurb: Moonlight dissects the waves with scientific clarity — the sublime, measured in lumens.

artworks.title: The Dreaming Moon
artworks.blurb: The moon dissolves into velvet darkness, a radiant eye in the deep blue night.

artworks.title: Windows on the Dark
artworks.blurb: Warm windows burn against the blue-black sky; the city refuses the night's surrender.

artworks.title: Vision of Sand
artworks.blurb: A visionary glow rises from the sand — the beach reimagined as a secret, sacred place.

artworks.title: The Haunted Sea
artworks.blurb: Thick impasto waves carry a haunted moon; the lake dreams its own ghost story.

artworks.title: Ashen Night
artworks.blurb: Straw and ash tones bury the shoreline in monumental melancholy — night as history.

artworks.title: Blurred Nocturne
artworks.blurb: The moon softens into a beautiful blur; memory and water become indistinguishable.

artworks.title: Storm of Night
artworks.blurb: Clouds churn around a veiled moon — passion and tempest over the sleeping lake.

artworks.title: Prismatic Towers
artworks.blurb: The skyline shatters into crystal geometry; the city lights up in fragments of color.

artworks.title: Machine Night
artworks.blurb: Crisp towers rise in streamlined silence — the precision of a city dreaming.

artworks.title: Night Over the Railing
artworks.blurb: Vivid color floods the skyline; even midnight feels electric with light.

artworks.title: Sunset in Bands
artworks.blurb: Bands of radiant color dissolve into a glowing horizon — dusk as meditation.

artworks.title: Crown of the Sunset
artworks.blurb: Crowns and graffiti marks scrawl across a burning orange skyline — the city speaks in symbols.

artworks.title: Symphony of the Shore
artworks.blurb: The aerial lakefront dissolves into circles and arcs — a spiritual geometry of blue and gold.

artworks.title: The Grid Breaks
artworks.blurb: Primary blocks snap into rhythm — until the curving shoreline breaks the grid.

artworks.title: Pollen Spell
artworks.blurb: A single yellow bloom multiplies into a thousand dots — night's garden, dreaming in yellow.

artworks.title: The Weight of Stone
artworks.blurb: Solid rocks, honest earth — the breakwater rendered with a realist's reverence for matter.

artworks.title: Sparkling Afternoon
artworks.blurb: Luminous sky and sparkling water — an afternoon on the inland sea.

artworks.title: Honest Water
artworks.blurb: Homer's rugged truth: wind, whitecaps, and a beach that doesn't perform.

artworks.title: The Watcher
artworks.blurb: Rex stands guard among the rocks, painted with Wyeth's quiet devotion.

artworks.title: Muscle of the Lake
artworks.blurb: Benton's sculptural waves roll against the tower's steady geometry.

artworks.title: Still Water, Passing Ducks
artworks.blurb: A woodblock calm: ducks cross soft water beneath the breakwater's dark line.

artworks.title: Flight Study
artworks.blurb: Klee lifts the gull into whimsy — a bird, a line, a small mid-air joy.

artworks.title: The Sentinel
artworks.blurb: Wood's tower stands at monumental attention over a calm Midwestern sea.

artworks.title: Sand Into Sky
artworks.blurb: Color bleeds and soaks: the beach dissolves into pure luminous wash.

artworks.title: Almost In Frame
artworks.blurb: Katz catches the tower flat and cool — and Rex's snout sneaking in at the edge.

artworks.title: City in Silver
artworks.blurb: Corot's mist turns the skyline into a memory of itself.

artworks.title: Bravura Haze
artworks.blurb: Sargent's watercolor bravura: the city sketched in light and weather.

artworks.title: Floodlights in the Dark
artworks.blurb: Caravaggio's spotlight rips the park trees from the night — light as violence, dark as velvet.

artworks.title: The Walker's Hour
artworks.blurb: Vermeer's quiet hour: a walker and a dog, small against the tower, held in pearl-gray light.

artworks.title: The Sand Is a Stage
artworks.blurb: Böcklin's nocturne — the floodlit sand becomes a stage, the tower a silent sentinel.

artworks.title: Gentle Water
artworks.blurb: Pissarro's soft morning: waves combing the sand in broken, breathing color.

artworks.title: The City from Above
artworks.blurb: Canaletto's grand view — the Chicago skyline rendered with veduta majesty.

artworks.title: The Tower at Noon
artworks.blurb: Caillebotte's clean daylight: sand, water, and concrete in crisp modern planes.

artworks.title: Green Before the Lake
artworks.blurb: Sisley's luminous green — the grassy foreground shimmering before the lake.

artworks.title: Grass and Pavement
artworks.blurb: Morisot's feathery lightness turns a sidewalk's edge into a plein-air reverie.

artworks.title: The Far Figure
artworks.blurb: Bonnard's shimmer — the distant walker dissolving into warm, dappled light.

artworks.title: Pale Water
artworks.blurb: Vuillard's veiled light: the beach seen through a soft, intimate haze.

artworks.title: The White Building
artworks.blurb: Derain's fauve joy — electric blues and oranges set the beach alight.

artworks.title: Grass at the Barrier
artworks.blurb: Vlaminck's slashing color — a turbulent sky over the grassy shore.

artworks.title: Facets of Shore
artworks.blurb: Braque's quiet cubism: the shoreline broken into faceted planes of ochre and gray.

artworks.title: Concrete Pastoral
artworks.blurb: Léger's machine-age pastoral — barriers and pavement rebuilt as bold tubular forms.

artworks.title: The Electric Grid
artworks.blurb: Kirchner's electric night — acid yellows slashing through the city's dark.

artworks.title: Night over the Railing
artworks.blurb: Nolde's brooding glow — the skyline burning through a heavy night sky.

artworks.title: Gold on Velvet
artworks.blurb: Titian's sumptuous night — golden sand against velvet darkness.

exhibits.description: Forty-four studies of one shoreline. Each piece begins as a photograph taken on the Lake Michigan beach — the rock breakwaters, the beacon towers, the long pink dusks — and is then reimagined through the hand of a master of art history. Walk the same sand forty-four times, and never see it the same way twice.
exhibits.subtitle: Lake Michigan shoreline studies, reimagined through forty-four masters
exhibits.title: Beach
Nocturne
exhibits.subtitle: Night on the water — ten moonlit studies in the masters' hands
exhibits.description: When the sun goes down, the beach changes its language. Moonlight on the breakwater, clouds torn by silver, a lone figure by the rocks — ten nocturnal studies, each reimagined through a master of the night: Redon, Ryder, Kiefer, Delacroix, and more.

exhibits.title: City
exhibits.subtitle: Chicago after dark and from above — seven urban visions
exhibits.description: The skyline glittering through a balcony railing, sunsets burning orange over the grid, the lakefront seen from the sky. Seven visions of the city, filtered through cubists, precisionists, and color-field dreamers.

exhibits.title: Shore
exhibits.subtitle: Daylight studies — flower, stone, and sparkling afternoon
exhibits.description: Daylight returns: a hypnotic flower blooming in dots, rocks rendered with a realist's weight, and an afternoon beach sparkling like 19th-century France.
